PREPARATION.TITLE: Project Preparation
PREPARATION.SUBTITLE: Project Kickoff & Governance Alignment
PREPARATION.INTRO: A large and crucial ERP project requires clear, detailed direction and shared understanding across all teams. In this foundational phase, we ensure all stakeholders understand their responsibilities and project milestones.
POINTS: Define primary business objectives and expected project outcomes
Establish exact software scope and operational boundaries
Appoint project leaders and core steering committee from both sides
Identify key divisions and end-users participating in rollout
Audit required master data and assign data governance owners
Finalize project timeline, cutover deadlines, and target go-live date
Prepare necessary hardware, server infrastructure, and network devices
PREPARATION.OUTPUT_TEXT: Project Kick Off Presentation & Charter defining clear guidelines, milestones, and governance to ensure shared alignment.

BLUEPRINT.TITLE: Business Blueprint
BLUEPRINT.SUBTITLE: Process Mapping & System Architecture
BLUEPRINT.INTRO: In this crucial phase, detailed Focus Group Discussions (FGD) are held to evaluate current business workflows and design optimized future-state processes.
BLUEPRINT.BODY_1: We map out exact adjustments and additions required in the system to support your unique business operations. The primary deliverable is a comprehensive Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for each company division.
BLUEPRINT.BODY_2: The finalized blueprint document is thoroughly socialized and signed off by all key stakeholders, establishing a unified foundation before development begins.
BLUEPRINT.OUTPUT_TEXT: Signed Business Blueprint Document & Division SOP Matrix aligned across all stakeholder teams.

REALIZATION.TITLE: Realization
REALIZATION.SUBTITLE: System Configuration & Agile Development
REALIZATION.INTRO: Translating the Business Blueprint SOPs into software configurations, customized workflows, and module setups on a structured schedule.
REALIZATION.BODY_1: Customized modules undergo intensive testing by key users and continuous monitoring by dedicated project leads to ensure 100% alignment with operational requirements.
REALIZATION.BODY_2: We employ the Agile Development Methodology, fostering close collaboration and rapid feedback cycles with your team for on-time and accurate deployment.
REALIZATION.OUTPUT_TEXT: Fully Configured ERP System with verified custom workflows and tested database integration.

FINAL_PREP.TITLE: Final Preparation
FINAL_PREP.SUBTITLE: Comprehensive Simulation & Cutover Readiness
FINAL_PREP.INTRO: Comprehensive end-to-end system testing and user validation to ensure absolute readiness prior to production launch.
POINTS: Complete end-to-end User Acceptance Testing (UAT) following agreed SOPs
Hands-on training sessions for all operational software users
Data cut-off verification and final initial data migration
Hardware, network, and scanner/terminal device verification
Contingency planning and go-live readiness sign-off
FINAL_PREP.OUTPUT_TEXT: Successful UAT Sign-off, Trained User Certification, and Validated Cutover Master Data.

GO_LIVE.TITLE: Go Live & Support
GO_LIVE.SUBTITLE: Production Launch & Continuous Optimization
GO_LIVE.INTRO: The system goes live into active daily production. Internal and external monitoring teams ensure seamless execution across all organizational units.
GO_LIVE.BODY_1: Real-time on-site and remote monitoring allows immediate problem solving, performance tuning, transaction recording assistance, and master data refinement.
GO_LIVE.BODY_2: Our dedicated support team provides refresher training and optimization guidance as teams transition fully into automated, digital operations.
GO_LIVE.OUTPUT_TEXT: Live Production Operations, System Stabilization, and Ongoing Dedicated Support Service.
